name: Fort Riley
tagline: Home of the 1st Infantry Division, the 'Big Red One,' in the Kansas Flint Hills.
_note: Army post (Flint Hills, KS; Junction City + Manhattan/KSU). Facts verified from official sources (home.army.mil/riley, irwin.tricare.mil, riley.corviaspm.com, DeCA/AAFES, Wikipedia for corroborated headline facts). BAH MHA KS100 (Fort Riley) via the bah_rates single source of truth. Housing operated by Corvias. Medium-confidence flags: base coords (approx), representative off-base ZIP 66441 (Junction City). Rechecked 2026-11-11 (research/riley-facts.md): USD 475 runs all five on-post schools; gates per the visitor page of 9/11/26 (Trooper and Four Corners closed); Corvias Military Living about 3,865 homes; IACH keeps its ER per Sen. sections.title: Mission & Identity
data: Fort Riley is home to the 1st Infantry Division, the 'Big Red One,' the oldest continuously serving division in the Regular Army. It sits in the Flint Hills of northeast Kansas.
The division deploys units in 2026. The Little Apple Post reported in January 2026 that at the low point 6,000 to 8,000 soldiers would remain on post, with about 15,000 family members staying.

sections.title: Junction City or Manhattan? Flint Hills Living

data.subtitle: The main choice is the Junction City side in Geary County, the district that runs every school on post, or Manhattan and Ogden in Riley County. Kansas property tax doesn't change with your state of residence, so it comes down to schools, prices, sales tax and your gate.
intro: BAH is the same wherever you live, and Kansas assesses every home at 11.5% of its value whatever your state of residence; the first $75,000 is exempt from the 20-mill statewide school levy (about $172 a year). Ask the county for the combined mill levy at any address; it varies by city. Sales tax is 9.75% in Junction City and Grandview Plaza, 9.15% in Manhattan (Riley County part), 8.2% in Ogden and 7.75% in Milford.

Zillow's typical home value in September 2026 was $200,051 in Junction City (down 3.1% in a year), $294,183 in Manhattan (up 4.5%) and $177,742 in Ogden (up 16.9%). Typical rents were $1,132 in Junction City and $1,315 in Manhattan, including apartments.

recommendations.advice: Grandview Plaza is about 3 minutes from Henry Gate, Ogden about 3 from Ogden Gate and Junction City about 8 from Grant or Henry Gate, with no traffic.

Home of Kansas State University, about 17 minutes from Ogden Gate. Typical values rose 4.5% in the year to September 2026, and sales tax is 9.15% against 9.75% in Junction City. Schools are Manhattan-Ogden USD 383.
Corvias Military Living manages about 3,865 homes in five neighborhoods. Wait times vary by rank and bedroom needs.
Living in Junction City keeps children in Geary County Schools (USD 475), which runs all five schools on post, so a move on or off post needn't change schools.

source.label: Kansas Department of Revenue, property tax basics

sections.title: Gates & Access
data: Henry Gate (I-70 Exit 301) is the main gate and is open 24 hours; the Visitor Control Center is in Building 885 just outside it (785-239-2982; weekdays 5 a.m. to 9 p.m., weekends and holidays 8 a.m. to 4 p.m.). Ogden Gate (K-18 from Manhattan) is open 24/7, and the post lists Grant Gate (Grant Avenue from Junction City) as currently open 24/7.

Parker Gate, off U.S. 77, is open around the clock only while Four Corners Gate is closed for Rubio Road repairs; normally it opens weekdays 5 a.m. to 7 p.m. Trooper Gate is closed. Visitors need a REAL ID-compliant license or ID, and a second ID may be required. Gate status changes, so confirm on the official site before you go.

sections.title: On-Base Housing
data: On-post family housing is privatized and managed by Corvias Military Living: about 3,865 homes in five neighborhoods (Colyer Forsyth, Ellis Heights, Historic Main Post, McClellan Place and Warner-Peterson).
Wait times vary by rank and bedroom needs. Corvias Leasing and Relocation Office: 45 Barry Avenue, 785-717-2258, weekdays 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Army Housing Office: 785-239-3525.

source.label: DoD 2026 BAH Rates, MHA KS100 (Fort Riley)

sections.title: Schools
data: There are no DoD schools at Fort Riley. Geary County Schools (USD 475) runs all five schools on post (Ware, Seitz, Fort Riley and Morris Hill elementaries and Fort Riley Middle School), and high school students go to Junction City High School, which reported a 91.7% graduation rate in March 2026 (year not given). Manhattan and Ogden are Manhattan-Ogden USD 383, which reported 83.3% across the district for 2025. One is a school and the other a district, so compare high schools on the Kansas report card.

Before you have a Fort Riley address, you can enroll at Morris Hill Elementary or Fort Riley Middle School with any address in the continental United States. Off post, your district depends on the address, so confirm it. School Liaison Office: 6620 Normandy Drive, 785-240-3261.

data.Care: Hospital on post with emergency care (785-239-7777) and inpatient care. After reports in late 2024 of a possible downgrade, Sen. Roger Marshall said on May 1, 2026 that the Defense Health Agency confirmed no downgrades or reductions at this time.

source.label: Military OneSource, Fort Riley health care

intro: Whether to rent or buy is the biggest money decision of most PCS moves, and the answer is mostly about how long you'll be here and how steady the local market is.
rent: Your tour is short (about two years or less) or your orders feel uncertain.
You want time to learn the area before committing to a neighborhood.
You'd rather not gamble on resale timing when you PCS out.
Your BAH comfortably covers rent in the areas you'd consider.
buy: You expect to be here three or more years.
You want to use your VA loan and build equity instead of paying rent.
You've checked resale on your side of post: typical values fell 3.1% in Junction City and rose 4.5% in Manhattan in the year to September 2026.
You've found a neighborhood and commute you're confident about.
data.bottom_line: There is no universal right answer. Prices are moving in opposite directions on the two sides of post, so check resale where you'd buy. Run your BAH against the rent and home prices above, weigh your tour length, and talk to a lender and an agent who work with military families before you commit.

intro: The first month at a new duty station is mostly logistics. Knocking these out early makes everything else easier.

steps.title: Line up temporary lodging
steps.text: Book on-base lodging or a short-term rental before you arrive. You can claim Temporary Lodging Expense (TLE) for a limited number of days while you house-hunt.

steps.title: In-process and update DEERS
steps.text: Report to your unit and finance, and make sure DEERS and ID cards are current for every family member so TRICARE and base access work.

steps.title: Start with the Housing Office
steps.text: Check on-base availability and get the housing office's read on Junction City and Manhattan before you sign anything.

steps.title: Sort your vehicle and base access
steps.text: You can keep your car registered in your home state. If you register it in Kansas and Kansas isn't your legal residence, it's exempt from vehicle property tax but not sales tax; bring your LES to the county treasurer. Geary County says a car registered elsewhere for less than six months may owe sales tax, leased cars don't qualify and out-of-state cars need a VIN inspection.

steps.title: Enroll the kids in school
steps.text: Children on post attend Geary County Schools (USD 475). Before you move, you can enroll at Morris Hill Elementary or Fort Riley Middle School with any address in the continental United States. School Liaison: 785-240-3261.

steps.title: Set up healthcare
steps.text: Update your TRICARE enrollment so you can be seen at Irwin Army Community Hospital or network providers.

data.a: The 1st Infantry Division, the 'Big Red One,' the oldest continuously serving division in the Army. The post counts about 15,400 active-duty soldiers.

Junction City is closer to Henry and Grant gates, cheaper (typical value $200,051 in September 2026) and in the same school district as the post. Manhattan, about 17 minutes from Ogden Gate, costs more ($294,183) but values are rising, and sales tax is lower (9.15% against 9.75%).

It depends on the side of post. Typical rents in September 2026 were $1,132 in Junction City and $1,315 in Manhattan, including apartments (Zillow). Compare them with your BAH above for the size of home you need.
Fort Riley is MHA KS100. Use the calculator above for your grade.

data.q: Does Kansas tax my military pay?
data.a: Only if Kansas is your legal residence: 5.2% on the first $23,000 of taxable income and 5.58% above that ($46,000 for joint returns), with no automatic cut for 2026 or 2027. A nonresident member's military pay isn't taxed, nor a spouse's Kansas wages when the spouse is in Kansas only because of the orders. Military retirement pay is exempt.
